fact: The national startup labelling committee, created by decree of 5 June 2026, held its first meeting on 4 November 2026 without secretariat, budget or bureau, so no label has yet been awarded under the 2022 Startup Act.
title: Loi sur les Startup : 4 ans après la promulgation, la RDC attend toujours un dispositif de labellisation opérationnel
